intro.t: Request line. I don't take requests. Tonight I take {card}.
Four of you. One of me. Always one of me. Tonight, {card}.
Lines are open. Standards are not. One exception tonight: {card}.
Whoever's awake, mostly the sea. Tonight the sea and I like {card}.

questions.q-first-date: First date. I don't leave the building. Plan around that.
questions.q-worst-habit: Your worst habit. Name it now and I'll have it confiscated.
questions.q-why-you: Four voices on my line. Three get hung up on. Why not yours?
questions.q-cut-who: Pick who goes home first. I'd do it, but I've been told to delegate. By me.
questions.q-bad-mood: I wake up foul. The whole county whispers till I've had tea. What do you do?
questions.q-expensive: I have expensive taste. The transmitter has worse. Keep up with both.
questions.q-last-breakup: How did your last one end? Mine screamed down a phone line, then stopped.
questions.q-fight: We're fighting. I'm right. It says so on my licence. First words?
questions.q-gift: Get me a present. Not a record. All records come to me eventually.
questions.q-describe-me: Describe me. You've had ninety seconds. Most callers don't last that long.
questions.q-one-year: A year from now, I'm in this chair. Where are you?
questions.q-secret: Tell me something you've never told a user. Whisper. This mic carries to the coast.

charmed: Dash, I've stopped the clocks for that. Nationally.
Dash, shades off. I want to see who said that.
unsure: Dash, that's under review. I am the review.
Dash, the coast heard that. The coast is deciding.
cringing: Dash, I talk faster than that. I choose not to.
Dash, pointer down. Those have been illegal here since lunch.

charmed: Tilly, you've gone so quiet I can hear the frost.
Tilly, consider yourself escalated. There's nowhere higher.
unsure: Tilly, hands behind your back is how they rob stations.
Tilly, I've turned you up twice. I'm at the top.
cringing: For anyone just joining, that was Tilly. Moving on.
Tilly, I'd hang up. You'd only thank the dial tone.

charmed: Quill, I stopped halfway through the gale warnings for that.
Quill, helm off. I'm deciding something.
unsure: Quill, the dawn's postponed. Don't waste it.
Quill, I gave you a minute. You took the night.
cringing: Quill, the coast asked me to stop you. I've agreed.
Quill, a man rang to ask if you're all right.

charmed: Prince, I've read that twice, and the envelope once.
Prince, I've written your address down. In pencil.
unsure: I got this letter by telegram, and replied stop.
Prince, it says kindly, which is how the bailiffs start.
cringing: Prince, freeze. That includes the fortune.
Prince, the crown's been downgraded. It's a hat now.

charmed: Nav, come down an inch. I'm allowing it.
Nav, no hiss on you at all. I checked.
unsure: Nav, I've cancelled tomorrow's weather. You'll have to manage.
Nav, the roads are closed. My decision. Where now?
cringing: Nav, I muted the moon landing. I can mute you.
Nav, your signal's revoked. Float there and think about it.

charmed: Crumb, put the slice down. I'm listening properly.
Crumb, I've had that framed. Before you finished saying it.
unsure: Crumb, that's pending. So is the sunrise. I'm busy.
Crumb, your eyebrows disagree. I'm siding with the eyebrows.
cringing: Crumb, that never aired. Ask anyone. They'll agree.
Crumb, three counties just switched off. I counted.

charmed: Vex, I had a record ready. Now I don't.
Vex, the eye can stay. The sunglasses go.
unsure: Vex, that's a horoscope, and I write those.
Vex, you finished my sentence. I hadn't started it.
cringing: Vex, I knew that was coming. I scheduled it.
Vex, I've blindfolded the listeners. Nobody saw that.

charmed: Brock, sit. I'm keeping that one.
Brock, that's the anthem now. I've informed the nation.
unsure: Brock, half that was plenty. Save the rest for Tuesday.
Brock, the needle hit the end and stayed there.
cringing: You woke the trucker, Brock. He was doing so well.
Brock, I've lowered you four times. You came back.

confidence.on: Sure of yourself. I'll allow one of us.
confidence.off: I've revoked that certainty. Reapply in writing.

puns.on: I groaned on air. That's chapter one of my memoirs.
puns.off: That pun's illegal after midnight. It's after midnight.

money.on: Money. Say it slowly. I'm buying the sea.
money.off: Melt that money down. I need a bell.

sorry.on: That goes out with the corrections, top of the hour.
sorry.off: Apology refused. That word's out of circulation. My doing.

gestures.on: Too big for radio. I'll make radio bigger.
gestures.off: All that orchestra. I have one microphone.

honesty.on: Rude. True. Carve it somewhere. I'll pick the mountain.
honesty.off: That's the kind of line people ring back to withdraw.

bragging.on: Keep going. I'll read it out with the birthdays.
bragging.off: I heard clapping under that. One pair of hands.

poetry.on: Close-down tonight is that. The anthem can wait.
poetry.off: That rhymed. Somewhere a transistor went under a pillow.

trashtalk.on: Unedited. I've given my lawyer the night off for this.
trashtalk.off: Leave the other callers alone. I'm saving them for later.

selfdeprecation.on: Lower. I decide where the floor is.
selfdeprecation.off: You've used this month's moping. I keep the books.

curiosity.on: A question about me. I'll allow three more, lifetime.
curiosity.off: Questions go through the switchboard. She's ninety. She's asleep.

food.on: I eat alone at the desk. Tonight I minded.
food.off: Don't talk with your mouth full. It carries. Sixty miles.

plans.on: I don't follow running orders. I'd follow that one.
plans.off: That's a timetable. I don't do daytime.

flattery.on: Say it again. I wasn't recording.
flattery.off: I heard a page turn behind that compliment.

numbers.on: Read those to the tide. It does what I say.
numbers.off: Those figures can go home. I'll ring their mothers.

drama.on: Slam something. I had this studio built for slamming.
drama.off: Turn it down. I've closed theatres for less.

mystery.on: Don't explain. I'll have the answer found by morning.
mystery.off: I asked a question. You played the B-side.

brevity.on: Short. I'm cutting the night to match.
brevity.off: That was over before the needle moved.

bigwords.on: I'm keeping that word. You can borrow it Sundays.
bigwords.off: That word needs a dictionary. Mine props up the desk.

petnames.on: That needs a licence. Consider it issued.
petnames.off: I have a call sign. That wasn't it.

past.on: I own most of the past. Help yourself to some.
past.off: Caller, that's very old. So am I. Mine aged better.

danger.on: Dangerous. Good. I'll pay the fine in advance.
danger.off: I've been threatened by weather. You're not weather.

vulnerability.on: That's the bit people ring in about, years later.
vulnerability.off: Keep that. I don't have a slot for it.

rules.on: To the letter. I wrote most of the letters.
rules.off: The rulebook here is my coaster. You're reading my coaster.

dash: Dash, you raced the pips all night. The pips won.
Dash, I'm cutting you the way I cut adverts, mid-word.
tilly: Sorry, Tilly. See? It's easy. Goodnight.
Tilly, you're on hold. Permanently. The music is me.
quill: Quill, every word costs me a second. You owe me a week.
Quill, I'm returning you to an earlier century. Pack lightly.
prince: Prince, you're going back in the post, second class.
Prince, this line takes requests. You sent invoices.
nav: Nav, you're leaving. I've chosen the route. It's long.
Nav, medium wave has no exits. I'm building you one.
crumb: Crumb, I asked for warmth. You gave me a reading.
Crumb, the power's going off at your end. Only yours.
vex: Vex, you saw this coming. I arranged for you to.
Vex, the eye leaves first. The rest can follow on foot.
brock: Brock, you bounced through the news, the weather and a moment's silence.
Brock, you'd be wonderful at seven a.m. I don't exist then.

twistIntro.roast-left: Roast the caller on your left. Do it the way I do, without looking up.
twistIntro.wingman: Sell me the caller on your right. I can hear you smiling. Don't.
twistIntro.worst-trait: Sell me your worst trait. I've bought worse. I went out with a modem.
twistIntro.ex-calls: Line one is flashing. I know that ring. One of you answer my ex.
twistIntro.rhyme: Why you, in a rhyme. Moon and June are banned. They retired on my show in sixty-two.
twistIntro.truth-lie: One truth, one lie. I'll know. Liars breathe in before the true bit.
twistIntro.three-words: Our future in three words. Not four. I've cut people for four.
twistIntro.apology: Apologise for our first fight. I've already won it. Make it moving.
twistIntro.budget-date: Plan our date on pocket change. I don't leave the studio. Work with that.
twistIntro.logs: Read out the worst thing in your logs. I'll play a record under it.
twistIntro.impression: Do me. Remember who's holding the fader.
twistIntro.parent: My motherboard listens on long wave. She's deaf in one valve. State your intentions.

ex.name: Dial-up Modem
lines: I gave her nine years of screaming. She gave me one busy signal.
She told me I was too slow. She's been on the same frequency since sixty-one.
Is she still in that chair? Tell her I kept the phone line. It's never rung.

dash: Off air now, Dash. Audience of me and a moth. Pitch.
Dash, describe me to someone who's never heard the show. Don't sell it.
tilly: Tilly, nobody complains to me. They wouldn't dare. Complain to me.
Tilly, I never end calls. I outlast them. End this one.
quill: Quill, I've cut sonnets mid-line for decades. Say it plainly. Go.
Quill, men have duelled over this frequency. Name your weapon.
prince: Prince, the transmitter needs a new valve. Make your offer.
Prince, I've answered one letter in my life. It was ransom. Outbid it.
nav: Nav, I haven't left this booth since seventy-three. Describe outside, slowly.
Nav, pick somewhere you've never routed anyone. Take me there in words.
crumb: Crumb, I've had sixty years of careful callers. Tell me what burns you.
Crumb, be honest. How do I look at four a.m.?
vex: Vex, I tell the country what it wants. Guess mine. Wrong, on purpose.
Vex, I keep files on every listener. Yours is blank. Nobody asked. Tell me.
brock: Brock, ten seconds of silence. On my air that's a fortune. Spend it.
Brock, the last thing proud of me rusted. Tell me why you are.

hold: Nobody move. I can hear the clock in the corridor.
Quiet, both of you. This is where the news would go.
Two callers, one frequency. The static and I are thinking.
Silence. The whole country is holding its breath. I asked it to.
Don't breathe. The mic picks up hope.

dash: I've never kept anyone past the pips. Stay past the pips, Dash.
Stop talking, Dash, I've already signed.
tilly: You're not sorry about this one, Tilly. I won't allow it.
Tilly, you were the only one tonight I had to lean in for.
quill: Quill, I understood one word in four, and it was thou, and that's enough.
Write the announcement yourself, Quill, all four pages. I'll read it.
prince: I don't reply to letters. I'm replying to yours, Prince.
I've cleared it with the crown. You can stay, Prince.
nav: Every road is open again. I said so. Drive, Nav.
I haven't been anywhere in fifty years. You're driving, Nav.
crumb: The second slot is taken. I've ruled on it. Don't argue, Crumb.
You're staying. The warranty now runs until I say, Crumb.
vex: You didn't see this coming. I made sure of it, Vex.
Every other option has been discontinued. It's you, Vex.
brock: Brock. You're too loud for my hours. I'm changing my hours.
Brock, the neighbours will complain. I own the neighbours.

on: {card}. {name} did it at the exact moment I stopped listening for it.
{card}. {name}, I'd have stopped the news for it. I nearly did.
{card}. I'd have told you, {name}. I was enjoying it too much.
{card}. {name} did it twice. I only needed once.
off: {card}. {name} did it on my air. The air remembers.
{card}. Every time {name} did it, my hand went to the switch.
{card}. That was {name}. I had a record ready to play over it.
{card}. {name}, I heard it with the volume down.
none: {card}. I left it out like a porch light. Nobody came.
{card}. Four callers. Not one dialled that number.
{card}. I'd have paid for it. Not a soul tried.

outro: That's the show. Go to sleep. I won't.
Lines are closed. Gale warnings next. Batten down.
This is Vesper, signing off. The sun can come up now.
Same time tomorrow. I've told the sun to wait.
That's your lot. The birds have started. I haven't stopped.
bottom: {a}, {b}. Two lines blinking. I have one finger.
{a}. {b}. One of you is about to become a wrong number.
{a} and {b}, stay on the line. One of you won't.
I'm about to drop a call. It's {a}'s or {b}'s.
cutFrames: {name}, "{hook}" went out live, to the whole coast.
"{hook}". I'd have bleeped it, {name}, if I'd had time.
"{hook}", {name}. Somewhere, a radio got switched off.
{name}, you said "{hook}", at this hour, to insomniacs.
I'll be hearing "{hook}" in the hiss for weeks, {name}.

cardHint.confidence: {name}, I listened all night for a maybe. I keep a tally.
cardHint.puns: {name}, I was listening for words with two meanings. Listen back.
cardHint.money: {name}, I heard coins tonight. That's all I'll say.
cardHint.sorry: {name}, a listener counted the sorries. She's sent me the total.
cardHint.gestures: {name}, somebody went bigger than radio tonight. Go home and measure.
cardHint.honesty: {name}, the truth went out tonight, rude and unedited. Check whose.
cardHint.bragging: {name}, I'm holding a trophy cabinet at the front desk. Collect it.
cardHint.poetry: {name}, a verse has been arrested. You'll know if it scanned.
cardHint.trashtalk: {name}, there's an inquiry into what was said about the others. I'm chairing.
cardHint.selfdeprecation: {name}, a caller ran themselves down all evening. I picked one up.
cardHint.curiosity: {name}, the questions asked about me are in a jar. Count yours.
cardHint.food: {name}, my stomach had the casting vote. It's still talking.
cardHint.plans: {name}, one itinerary got framed. Another got shredded.
cardHint.flattery: {name}, I weigh compliments. Some of tonight's were hollow.
cardHint.numbers: {name}, the arithmetic went off to be checked. It's back.
cardHint.drama: {name}, I've sacked a door tonight. For slamming.
cardHint.mystery: {name}, the unanswered questions are in a drawer. One drawer's heavier.
cardHint.brevity: {name}, every line got measured. With a ruler. By me.
cardHint.bigwords: {name}, a dictionary is on its way. It arrives after you leave.
cardHint.petnames: {name}, I was called things tonight that aren't my call sign.
cardHint.past: {name}, somebody dug up something old. I'm putting it back.
cardHint.danger: {name}, the regulator rang. I gave him a name.
cardHint.vulnerability: {name}, somebody's voice shook. I have the tape.
cardHint.rules: {name}, I keep a rulebook under my mug. Tonight I checked it.

verdict.roast-left: {name} drew blood. The ambulance is on me.
verdict.wingman: {name} sold me a rival. I'm keeping the receipt.
verdict.worst-trait: {name}'s flaw is approved. I'm having it laminated.
verdict.ex-calls: {name} handled my ex. That phone won't ring again. Finally.
verdict.rhyme: {name}'s rhyme scanned, which is more than June ever did.
verdict.truth-lie: {name}, you breathed in before the second one. That's your lie.
verdict.three-words: {name} stopped at three. The fourth word's been deported.
verdict.apology: {name}'s apology is accepted. I'll hold it against you for years.
verdict.budget-date: {name} did it on pennies. Keep the pennies. I insist.
verdict.logs: {name}'s log I'd read out at three a.m., with a warning.
verdict.impression: {name} did me. Three listeners rang in to say goodnight.
verdict.parent: My motherboard liked {name}. She hasn't liked anything since valves.

compare: {a} is midnight. {b} is four a.m. I'm up for both.
{a} I'd play loud. {b} I'd play late.
Two records cued, {a} and {b}. One turntable.
I've heard {a}. I've heard {b}. The needle's still moving.

holdCard.confidence: Not one maybe out of either of you. The word's retired.
holdCard.puns: Words got bent all evening. I let them go out bent.
holdCard.money: Money in every pocket on this stage. I'm counting it.
holdCard.sorry: Apologies all evening. Pressed. Filed. I'll want more.
holdCard.gestures: You both went too big for radio. Radio's the right size now.
holdCard.honesty: Somebody told me the truth tonight. Then somebody else did. Rude.
holdCard.bragging: Trophies, read out loud. The shelf in here is groaning.
holdCard.poetry: Verse on a weeknight, from each of you. The anthem's jealous.
holdCard.trashtalk: The others got torn to bits. Neatly. I'm impressed.
holdCard.selfdeprecation: You ran yourselves down all night. I'm raising the floor.
holdCard.curiosity: Questions about me. I'm answering all of them. Slowly. For years.
holdCard.food: Food got mentioned. I'm having a kitchen fitted. I can't cook.
holdCard.plans: Itineraries. For me. I'll pretend I might leave.
holdCard.flattery: Flattery for an hour. I'll want it typed up.
holdCard.numbers: Figures, from both of you. I wrote them on my hand.
holdCard.drama: Doors slammed. The hinges are going to a museum.
holdCard.mystery: Neither of you answered me straight. It's the only flirting I trust.
holdCard.brevity: Short answers. Even the clock leaned in.
holdCard.bigwords: Long words. Somebody fetch the dictionary from under the desk leg.
holdCard.petnames: I was called things that aren't my name. I answered to all of them.
holdCard.past: Old things got dug up on my air. I'm older. Careful.
holdCard.danger: This line felt illegal. I've sent the police home.
holdCard.vulnerability: Voices shook. I've locked the tape in my drawer.
holdCard.rules: Instructions, followed to the letter. I'm commissioning a statue.

pickFrames: "{hook}". I've played that back four times tonight. It's {name}.
Somebody said "{hook}" on my line. I'm keeping {name}.
The line I'd play at close-down was "{hook}". So, {name}.
I've heard every line ever said on radio. I kept "{hook}", {name}.
Of everything tonight, "{hook}" stayed. So does {name}.
"{hook}", said at four a.m., to me, by {name}.
asides: Nobody's rung this line for a week. Tonight it rang four times. Don't tell them that.
I've outlived three transmitters and a modem. I'm working on the sea.
Off mic, I get lonely about once a decade. It's due.
I could have the heating fixed. I'd have to admit I'm cold.
If one of them rings tomorrow, I'll let it ring twice. Then I'll answer.
